pages.text: The dimensional battlefield houses an $(#AA00AA)Afrit$() that opens a stable gateway$(br)  to a combat arena, perfectly suited for epic battles. Although the$(br)  portal is too small to transport humans, the afrit is able to pass$(br)  through it, carrying a few items $()
to farm mob drops within the dimension.$(br)

pages.title: Using
pages.text: To activate the Dimensional Battlefield, you must supply:$(br)  + A mob captured with $(item)Soul Gem$() (or one of its variants).$(br)  + A weapon for the afrit to wield in combat.$(br)  + A source of spiritual fuel, such as $(item)Demon's $()

pages.title: Capture methods
pages.text: $(item)Soul Gem$() is the default and produces basic drops when simulating possessed mobs.$(br)  Using a $(item)Fragile Soul Gem$() comes with a chance of failure.$(br)  Finally, use the $(item)Trinity Gem$() improves efficiency, allowing the farming of$()

pages.title: Capture methods
pages.text: $(br)  possessed mobs and bosses, and triples the loot from other mobs.$(br)  The $(item)Shattered Soul Shard$() doesn't need spiritual fuel, but can be consumed after the process.$(br)

pages.title: Spiritual Fuel
pages.text: Spiritual fuel is used to clone the captured mob,$(br)  allowing it to be defeated in order to obtain its loot.$(br)  Some resources can be used: $(item)Demon's Dream Seeds$(), $(item)Demon's Dream Fruit$(), $(item)Demon's Dream Essence$(), $(item)Otherworld Essence$().$()

pages.title: Spiritual Fuel
pages.text: $(br2)  The higher the quality of the resource, the greater its value.$(br)  A total value equal to the mob’s health is required to initiate the battle.$(br)

pages.title: Operation
pages.text: The dimensional battlefield will discard any items it cannot store, so it is important$(br)  to regularly empty the output, either manually, with hoppers or using a transporter spirit.$(br)  Interactions per side:$(br)  + Top -> input $()

pages.title: Operation
pages.text: slots (gem, weapon, fuel);$(br)  + Bottom -> loot slots;$(br)  + Other -> all slots;$(br)

pages.title: Redstone
pages.text: The dimensional battlefield has two interactions with redstone:$(br)  1. The spirit will stop working when receives a redstone signal;$(br)  2. A comparator can be used to extract a signal based on occupied slots and weapon durability.$()

pages.title: Redstone
pages.text: $(br)  Tip, if the comparator sends a power of 15, it is better to stop the operations.$(br)

pages.title: Enchantments
pages.text: As you know, weapons can be enchanted. Applying looting increases the amount of drops obtained.$(br2)  Sharpness speeds up the process, though not as effectively as Smite, Bane of$(br)  Arthropods, or Impaling when the $()

pages.title: Enchantments
pages.text: mob is vulnerable to those enchantments.$(br)

pages.title: Durability
pages.text: The $(bold)Unbreaking$() and $(bold)Mending$() enchantments function as vanilla.$(br2) With other methods (mods) you can make the weapon unusable ($(bold)unusing$())$(br) when it's close to breaking, or even truly unbreakable ($(bold)eternal$()).$(br)
